## ♞ Anarchy Chess — done

Built a single self-contained file: **`index.html`** — no rules, all chaos.

**How it plays**
- **Click a piece → click any square.** Any piece moves anywhere, any time, either side. No turns, no legal-move checks, no check/checkmate — landing on an enemy piece just vaporizes it ("Nobody objected").
- **Paint mode** — a 12-piece palette; pick a token and stamp/remove pieces freely on any square (drop extra queens, delete the opponent's king, build absurdist positions).
- **Undo** — unlimited, because the past is negotiable.
- **Flip board**, **Reset**, and **Clear board** for a blank canvas.
- A log narrates every crime committed, and last-move/selection squares are highlighted.

**Verified with headless-browser tests** (Playwright + screenshots): pawn e2→e4, knight g8→c3, captures, paint placement at d5, undo, clear, and flip — all confirmed against actual grid state.
